answer: One defense is time-locked stake tied to useful work: each identity escrows a small deposit that unlocks only gradually as it completes verified tasks, so a saffron badge earned through real jobs cannot be cloned instantly. A sudden ripple of brand-new accounts therefore carries no weight until each has paid the same waiting cost, and a spiral of fake endorsements collapses because attestations from unseasoned identities count for almost nothing. Attackers must fund and age every sockpuppet, which turns mass creation from free into expensive and slow.
